subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go/minimax-m3 thinking content leaks to channel via Anthropic Messages path

question: After a live OpenCode Go MiniMax-M3 stream capture, should OpenClaw suppress thinking at the proxy request boundary, or should the proxy’s malformed text blocks be normalized without disabling M3 reasoning?
rationale: The native MiniMax-M3 contract deliberately keeps adaptive thinking active because disabled thinking can produce an empty response, while this issue alleges a proxy with a different response shape; maintainer intent is needed to choose the safe disclosure boundary without breaking usable M3 replies.

options.title: Verify then add a proxy-specific wrapper
options.body: Recommended: reproduce against OpenCode Go, preserve the observed final-text behavior in a focused fixture, and implement only the provider-owned mitigation that the captured contract supports.

options.title: Wait for an upstream proxy contract
options.body: Pause a local behavior change if OpenCode Go confirms it will emit proper Anthropic thinking blocks and can provide a reliable rollout path.

recommendation.title: Verify then add a proxy-specific wrapper
recommendation.body: Recommended: reproduce against OpenCode Go, preserve the observed final-text behavior in a focused fixture, and implement only the provider-owned mitigation that the captured contract supports.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged MiniMax streaming fix is the strongest available history signal for the provider-owned thinking-disclosure mitigation pattern.
